description: This script orchestrates the execution of the 'oxlint' tool by applying local policies, acquiring a lock before running, and handling process cleanup and error reporting.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Applies local Oxlint policies to command-line arguments and environment variables.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Acquires a lock to prevent concurrent heavy checks during the execution.
